Editor’s note: If you’ve cooked this beloved recipe before, it might look a little different these days! We made a darker gravy and start with frozen french fries to simplify the cooking process. It’s now even easier to follow and more delicious.Poutine — fries covered in a rich brown gravy and topped with cheese curds — is a French-Canadian dish that originated in Quebec as a delicious way to use up excess cheese curds, which have a short window of freshness.
